summary.en: Luckily, the two are able to survive thanks to Conan’s elasticity suspenders, however, they are soon confronted by a mysterious person that freaks Inami out. At the next morning, Kogoro, Arihara, Domon, Tanemura, and Ran are discussing why is the guitar box stolen 3 years ago now in Tanemura’s car when Ran reports to her father that Arihara had met with someone who appears to be the last member of Albarosa band but still expresses her worry toward Conan’s safety just as when she receives the call from Conan himself. He apologizes to her and Kogoro for not calling them earlier to tell that he were safe all the time, and tells everyone to stay there waiting for him and the others to arrive, with the footage of the thief 3 years ago sent to him.
